R1.floor: max(1e-3, quantile(.10, positive finite patient IQRs))
R1.fit: global label-blind outer FIT OOF per family, leave target out during LOO

posterior: exact predecessor class moments, common variance, nu10 unique-patient shrinkage, source raw/reversed/insufficient fallback; min3classpatients, ordered global, variance1e-6; Beta20, same MAP bounds/solver/tolerances; ratio expected counts decoder allk smallerk, original logit then canonical tie order

numerical_gate.clip_scope: each outer FIT fold; channel weighted all/source; no VAL-based selection

utility_gate.severe_collapse: Any nonfinite score/density/posterior/MAP, any MAP nonconvergence, or >20% near-boundary MAP or all/none decoded counts in any outer FIT LOO group. Fixed before data; screening only.
utility_gate.aggregation: patient appearance equal over 255 FIT appearances, preserve repeated IDs; full 5 folds only

bootstrap.unit: unique patient IDs retain all appearances

phase_order: unlabeled transport all combinations; class descriptive only admitted after inference
terminal_priority: ROBUST_POSTERIOR_TARGET_0P70_REACHED if admitted D3_R1 passes GateC and >=.700
NUMERICAL_REPAIR_WITHOUT_DECISION_GAIN if any R1 numeric admissible but no GateC; includes failed FIT utility, without asserting VAL effect when untested
OOF_TO_VAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE only if FIT utility passes, VAL gain fails, and transport descriptively material, not causal proof
PATIENT_MIXTURE_SIGNAL_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE if numeric configurations exist but no admitted arm
POSTERIOR_DENSITY_STILL_INVALID otherwise; decoder-only qualified result in report
public: aggregate hashes/counts/results only; no patient/channel rows
